$comment: DEPRECATED — this schema has been merged into jms-schema.json. Point your IDE / validator to json-schema/jms-schema.json instead.
title: JMS Queue / Topic Configuration (deprecated alias — use jms-schema.json)
description: DEPRECATED. Schema for per-destination JMS configuration files located in config/jms-config/. Merged into jms-schema.json.

destination.description: JMS queue or topic name (exact name as it exists on the broker).

destination_type.description: Whether this destination is a queue or a topic.

queue_manager_ref.description: Reference to a queue manager defined in queue-managers.yaml. Use 'default' to pick the first registered queue manager.

provider.description: JMS provider type. Must match the provider field on the referenced queue manager.

message.description: Message format settings for this destination.

format.description: Serialisation format for messages on this destination.

jms_properties.description: IBM MQ / JMS message delivery properties applied when producing to this destination.

persistence.description: Whether messages should be persisted (survive broker restart). Maps to MQPER_PERSISTENT.

priority.description: Message priority (0 = lowest, 9 = highest). Maps to MQPRI_*.

time_to_live.description: Alias for expiry_ms. Message time-to-live in milliseconds. 0 means no expiry.

correlation.description: Correlation ID extraction and propagation rules for this destination (mirrors the topic-config correlation structure).

extract.description: Ordered list of rules for extracting a correlation ID from incoming messages. Rules are tried in ascending priority order; the first successful extraction wins.

name.description: JMS property / header name to read from. Required when from=header.

expression.description: JSONPath expression to evaluate on the message body. Required when from=jsonpath.

priority.description: Evaluation order — lower values are tried first.

propagate.description: Rules for writing the resolved correlation ID into outgoing messages produced to this destination.

to_headers.description: JMS properties / headers to set on outgoing messages. Values support {{correlationId}} placeholder.
